deltaNote: DRC confirmed deaths rose from 62 to 64; Uganda from 1 to 2 confirmed deaths. The 2 Uganda deaths are the first Uganda fatalities beyond the initial confirmed case. Total deaths: 63 → 66 as of June 5.

label: Case Fatality Rate (2026 BDBV)
source: CDC / ECDC — DRC/Uganda Ebola tracking, 28 May 2026
contestNote: CFR ranges from 14.1% (18 confirmed deaths / 128 confirmed cases) to 25.2% (264 suspected deaths / 1,047 suspected-only cases). Mongbwalu local CFR ~27%. BDBV historically 25–47% CFR. Suspected deaths likely undercounted given 23% zone inaccessibility.

label: BDBV Vaccine Status — WHO Expert Panel Ruling (28 May 2026)
value: Ervebo ring vaccination HALTED — ChAdOx1 BDBV priority (2–3 mo to trial)
source: WHO R&D Blueprint Expert Panel, 28 May 2026; Oxford / Serum Institute of India
contestNote: WHO expert panel (28 May) ruled rVSV-ZEBOV (Ervebo) must NOT be used outside research settings for BDBV — ending off-label ring vaccination as currently structured. ChAdOx1 BDBV (Oxford/Serum Institute) is now highest-priority candidate; Phase 1 trials within 2–3 months pending additional animal data. rVSV BDBV (IAVI) 7–9 months. Therapeutics prioritized: MBP134, Maftivimab®, remdesivir (all clinical trial only). Obeldesivir proposed as post-exposure prophylaxis for contacts.
delta: Ervebo ring vaccination protocol under revision post-28 May WHO ruling
deltaNote: May 29: Ring vaccination with Ervebo suspended pending WHO expert panel implementation guidance. ChAdOx1 BDBV remains highest priority for Phase 1 human trials in ~2–3 months (Aug–Sep 2026). CEPI co-funding $45M. All candidates must be used exclusively within clinical trials per WHO.
